words.enDefinition: the time when daylight first appears in the morning

examples.en: We left at dawn to catch the early bus to the trailhead.
examples.zh: 我们「黎明」就出发，好赶上开往登山口的首班车。

examples.en: The bakery where I work opens before dawn every single morning.
examples.zh: 我打工的面包店每天「黎明」前就开门。

words.enDefinition: the dim period just after sunset before full darkness

examples.en: The streetlights switch on at dusk, around six in winter.
examples.zh: 路灯在「黄昏」时分亮起，冬天大约六点。

examples.en: Joggers fill the riverside path at dusk when the heat fades.
examples.zh: 暑气消退后，跑者在「黄昏」时挤满河边步道。

words.enDefinition: the time in the evening when the sun disappears

examples.en: We watched the sunset from the library roof after the barbecue.
examples.zh: 烧烤结束后，我们在图书馆屋顶看了「日落」。

examples.en: Sunset is around eight in summer, so the evenings feel long.
examples.zh: 夏天「日落」大约在八点，所以夜晚感觉很长。

words.enDefinition: the usual time when someone goes to sleep

examples.en: My bedtime is eleven on weekdays because morning classes start early.
examples.zh: 工作日我的「就寝时间」是十一点，因为早课很早。

examples.en: Reading a novel before bedtime helps me fall asleep much faster.
examples.zh: 「就寝时间」前读一会儿小说，能让我更快睡着。

words.enDefinition: any day of the working week from Monday to Friday

examples.en: On weekdays the campus gym stays quiet until five in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 「工作日」的校内健身房下午五点前人很少。

examples.en: Weekday mornings are hectic, so I prepare breakfast the night before.
examples.zh: 「工作日」早上很赶，所以我前一晚就备好早餐。

words.enDefinition: a period of two weeks, used mainly in British English

examples.en: Under my current lease, rent is due at the start of every fortnight.
examples.zh: 按我现在这份租约，房租每「两周」交一次。

examples.en: The flatmates meet once a fortnight to split the bills.
examples.zh: 室友们每「两周」碰头一次，一起分摊账单。

words.enDefinition: the hour when a shop or bar stops serving

examples.en: During exam weeks the library's closing time is pushed to midnight.
examples.zh: 考试周图书馆的「打烊时间」会延到午夜。

examples.en: We ordered quickly because the diner was ten minutes from closing time.
examples.zh: 餐馆离「打烊时间」只剩十分钟，我们赶紧点了餐。

words.enDefinition: the system of moving clocks forward one hour in spring

examples.en: Daylight saving time starts in March, so we lose an hour of sleep.
examples.zh: 「夏令时」三月开始，我们会少睡一个小时。

examples.en: I always forget to adjust my alarm for daylight saving time.
examples.zh: 我总是忘记为「夏令时」调闹钟。

collocations: the start of daylight saving time
set clocks for daylight saving time

words.enDefinition: a region that shares the same standard clock time

examples.en: Calling my parents means juggling a thirteen-hour time zone difference.
examples.zh: 给爸妈打电话得应付十三个小时的「时区」差。

examples.en: The webinar time was listed in another time zone, so I nearly missed it.
examples.zh: 讲座时间标的是另一个「时区」，我差点错过。

words.enDefinition: the tired feeling after flying across several time zones

examples.en: My jet lag was terrible after flying back from Shanghai.
examples.zh: 从上海飞回来后，我的「时差反应」特别严重。

examples.en: Sunlight and water help your body recover from jet lag faster.
examples.zh: 多晒太阳、多喝水能帮身体更快摆脱「时差反应」。

words.enDefinition: a person who regularly stays up very late

examples.en: My roommate is a night owl who codes until three in the morning.
examples.zh: 我室友是个「夜猫子」，写代码能写到凌晨三点。

examples.en: As a night owl, I do my best thinking after ten p.m.
examples.zh: 作为「夜猫子」，我晚上十点后思维最活跃。

collocations: stay up like a night owl

words.enDefinition: a clock that wakes you with a loud sound

examples.en: I set three alarm clocks because one never wakes me up.
examples.zh: 我定了三个「闹钟」，因为一个根本叫不醒我。

examples.en: Her alarm clock rang for ten minutes before she heard it.
examples.zh: 她的「闹钟」响了十分钟她才听见。

words.enDefinition: a device or app that counts down a set period

examples.en: I use the timer app on my phone to pace my study sessions.
examples.zh: 我用手机上的「定时器」来控制学习节奏。

examples.en: Set a timer for the pasta so it does not boil over.
examples.zh: 给意面设个「定时器」，免得煮溢出来。

words.enDefinition: relaxed time when you are not working or studying

examples.en: I guard my Sunday downtime and refuse all study invitations.
examples.zh: 周日的「休息时间」我雷打不动，一律拒绝学习邀约。

examples.en: Even busy students need some downtime to avoid burning out.
examples.zh: 再忙的学生也需要一点「休息时间」，免得倦怠。

words.enDefinition: free time left over after classes, work, and daily duties

examples.en: In my spare time I volunteer at the campus food bank.
examples.zh: 「空闲时间」我会去校内食物银行做志愿者。

examples.en: She tutors math in her spare time to cover living costs.
examples.zh: 她利用「空闲时间」做数学家教，补贴生活费。

words.enDefinition: a night spent studying or working without sleeping

examples.en: I pulled an all-nighter to finish the essay due at nine.
examples.zh: 为了赶九点截止的论文，我「熬了个通宵」。

examples.en: Two all-nighters in one week left me sick with a cold.
examples.zh: 一周两次「通宵」让我感冒病倒了。

words.enDefinition: continuing until a time well after the evening

examples.en: We worked late into the night to finish the group slides before class.
examples.zh: 为了上课前完成小组幻灯片，我们忙得「一直到深夜」。

examples.en: The library stayed open late into the night during the final week of term.
examples.zh: 学期最后一周，图书馆营业「一直到深夜」。

collocations: stay open late into the night

words.enDefinition: recently, during the period leading up to now

examples.en: Lately the weather has been too rainy for weekend hikes.
examples.zh: 「最近」天气多雨，周末都没法去远足。

examples.en: Have you seen Mia lately, with her new silver hair?
examples.zh: 你「最近」见过米娅吗？就是染了银色头发那个。

words.enDefinition: earlier than an event, so you are prepared

examples.en: Check the bus schedule beforehand so you are not stranded.
examples.zh: 「事先」查好班车时刻表，免得被困在半路。

examples.en: Our professor emails the reading list beforehand every single week.
examples.zh: 教授每周都「事先」把阅读书单发邮件给我们。

words.enDefinition: after a short while, in a little while

examples.en: I am still eating, so I will head over in a bit.
examples.zh: 我还在吃饭，「待会儿」就过去。

examples.en: The shuttle should be here in a bit, so wait by the gate.
examples.zh: 班车「一会儿」就到，请在门口等。

collocations: call you back in a bit

words.enDefinition: the day following tomorrow, two days from now

examples.en: My presentation is the day after tomorrow, so tonight I rehearse.
examples.zh: 我的展示「后天」进行，所以今晚得排练。

examples.en: The forecast says it will rain again the day after tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天气预报说「后天」还会下雨。

words.enDefinition: the day that came before yesterday, two days ago

examples.en: The day before yesterday I finally picked up my student card.
examples.zh: 「前天」我终于领到了学生证。

examples.en: It snowed heavily the day before yesterday, then melted by noon.
examples.zh: 「前天」雪下得很大，到中午就化了。

words.enDefinition: immediately, without waiting even a moment

examples.en: The landlord said he would fix the heating right away.
examples.zh: 房东说他会「立刻」来修暖气。

examples.en: If the smoke alarm beeps, report it to the front desk right away.
examples.zh: 烟雾报警器要是响，请「马上」报告前台。

words.enDefinition: at the exact expected time, not late

examples.en: The shuttle is usually on time, but today it ran late.
examples.zh: 班车通常「准时」，但今天晚了。

examples.en: Handing in assignments on time protects your grade in most courses.
examples.zh: 「按时」交作业能保住你大部分课程的平时成绩。

words.enDefinition: with very little warning or preparation time

examples.en: The quiz was announced on short notice, so I skimmed my notes.
examples.zh: 测验是「临时通知」的，我只快速翻了翻笔记。

examples.en: Can you cover my cafe shift on short notice tomorrow morning?
examples.zh: 明天早上你能「临时」替我顶咖啡店的班吗？

words.enDefinition: at the latest possible moment before a deadline

examples.en: He signed up for the campus marathon at the last minute.
examples.zh: 他在「最后一刻」才报名校园马拉松。

examples.en: Never start writing your personal statement at the last minute.
examples.zh: 千万别「拖到最后一刻」才动笔写个人陈述。

words.enDefinition: earlier than the planned or expected time

examples.en: We finished the group poster two days ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 我们的小组海报「提前」两天完成了。

examples.en: The train arrived ahead of schedule, so I caught the earlier ferry.
examples.zh: 火车「提前」到站，我赶上了更早一班渡轮。

words.enDefinition: later than the planned or expected time

examples.en: The renovation is behind schedule, so the gym stays shut.
examples.zh: 装修「进度落后」，健身房还得继续关着。

examples.en: Heavy snow left every train on the line behind schedule.
examples.zh: 大雪让整条线路的火车都「晚点」了。

words.enDefinition: to be behind time and likely to arrive late

examples.en: Sorry, I am running late because the bus broke down.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我「快迟到了」，公交车半路抛锚了。

examples.en: The meeting ran late, so I had to skip my tutorial.
examples.zh: 会议开「超时」了，我只好翘掉辅导课。

words.enDefinition: to use up all the available time

examples.en: I ran out of time on the multiple-choice section again.
examples.zh: 选择题部分我又「没来得及做完」。

examples.en: We ran out of time before covering the last chapter.
examples.zh: 最后一章还没讲到，时间就「不够用」了。

collocations: run out of time in an exam

words.enDefinition: over a long period of time, considering the future

examples.en: Cooking at home instead of takeout saves money in the long run.
examples.zh: 自己做饭代替外卖，「长远来看」更省钱。

examples.en: Cramming feels fast, but steady review wins in the long run.
examples.zh: 突击虽然快，但「从长远看」稳扎稳打的复习更有效。

collocations: in the long run it pays off

words.enDefinition: for now, until the situation changes

examples.en: For the time being our study group is meeting online instead.
examples.zh: 「暂时」我们的学习小组先改为线上碰面。

examples.en: The old printer works for the time being, so do not order parts.
examples.zh: 旧打印机「眼下」还能用，先别订购配件。

words.enDefinition: during the period between two things happening

examples.en: The results come out Friday; in the meantime, keep revising.
examples.zh: 成绩周五公布，「在此期间」请继续复习。

examples.en: The cafe is closed for repairs; in the meantime, use the library one.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆停业整修，「这段时间」请用图书馆里的那家。

words.enDefinition: at some uncertain future time, eventually

examples.en: Sooner or later you will have to talk to the landlord yourself.
examples.zh: 「迟早」你得亲自和房东谈一次。

examples.en: Sooner or later the free trial ends, so back up your files.
examples.zh: 免费试用「早晚」会到期，记得先备份文件。

words.enDefinition: no later than the stated time

examples.en: Please submit the housing form by Friday at the latest.
examples.zh: 住宿申请表请尽快提交，「最迟」周五。

examples.en: I will text you by ten at the latest tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚「最迟」十点前会给你发短信。

words.enDefinition: on alternate days, with a day in between

examples.en: I water the plants in my dorm every other day.
examples.zh: 我「每隔一天」给宿舍的植物浇一次水。

examples.en: The free shuttle to the supermarket runs every other day.
examples.zh: 去超市的免费班车「隔天」发一班。

words.enDefinition: occasionally, but not very often

examples.en: Once in a while I skip cooking and order pizza instead.
examples.zh: 我「偶尔」会不做饭，改点披萨。

examples.en: Call your grandparents once in a while; they miss you.
examples.zh: 「偶尔」给爷爷奶奶打个电话，他们很想你。

collocations: once in a while treat yourself

words.enDefinition: very quickly, in a very short time

examples.en: With two people chopping, dinner was ready in no time.
examples.zh: 两个人一起切菜，晚饭「很快」就做好了。

examples.en: You will find your way around campus in no time.
examples.zh: 你「很快」就能摸清校园的路线。

words.enDefinition: for some period of time, not permanently

examples.en: I studied Japanese for a while before switching to Spanish.
examples.zh: 我「有一阵子」在学日语，后来换成了西班牙语。

examples.en: Let's sit on the lawn for a while before class.
examples.zh: 上课前我们在草坪上「坐一会儿」吧。

words.enDefinition: do something slowly and carefully, without rushing

examples.en: Take your time with the form; the deadline is next month.
examples.zh: 表格你「慢慢来」，截止日期在下个月。

examples.en: There is no rush, so take your time and double-check the figures.
examples.zh: 不着急，「慢慢来」，把数字再核对一遍。

words.enDefinition: at exactly the agreed or stated time

examples.en: The seminar starts at nine on the dot, so arrive early.
examples.zh: 研讨会九点「整」开始，请提前到场。

examples.en: Her alarm rings at six thirty on the dot every day.
examples.zh: 她的闹钟每天六点半「准时」响。

words.enDefinition: up until now, until this point

examples.en: So far this semester I have not missed a single lecture.
examples.zh: 「到目前为止」这个学期我一节课都没翘。

examples.en: The roommate search is going well so far, with three replies.
examples.zh: 找室友目前进展顺利，「至今」收到三个回复。

words.enDefinition: as early as you can manage

examples.en: Please reply to the advisor's email as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请「尽快」回复导师的邮件。

examples.en: Book the moving truck as soon as possible; September fills up.
examples.zh: 搬家货车要「尽早」预订，九月的档期很快订满。

words.enDefinition: before anything else, early in the day

examples.en: Email the professor first thing tomorrow morning about the extension.
examples.zh: 「明早第一件事」就是给教授发邮件申请延期。

examples.en: I check my schedule first thing when I wake up.
examples.zh: 我起床「第一件事」就是查看日程。

words.enDefinition: a few days ago, not long ago

examples.en: The other day I ran into our economics professor at the mall.
examples.zh: 「前几天」我在商场偶遇了经济学教授。

examples.en: Just the other day my roommate found a cheap bike on the marketplace app.
examples.zh: 就「前几天」，我室友在二手交易软件上淘到一辆便宜自行车。

words.enDefinition: to take much longer than expected

examples.en: The campus laundromat always seems to take forever on Sunday evenings.
examples.zh: 周日晚上校内自助洗衣店总是「慢得要命」。

examples.en: Waiting for the dorm elevator takes forever during morning rush.
examples.zh: 早高峰等宿舍电梯「要等好久」。

words.enDefinition: continuing through every season of the year

examples.en: The campus swimming pool stays open year-round, even during winter break.
examples.zh: 校游泳馆「全年」开放，寒假也不例外。

examples.en: This farmer's market runs year-round with covered stalls for snowy days.
examples.zh: 这个农夫市场「全年」营业，下雪天还有带顶棚的摊位。

words.enDefinition: slightly ill or not feeling well

examples.en: I feel a bit under the weather, so I will skip practice.
examples.zh: 我「有点不舒服」，今天就不去训练了。

examples.en: She stayed under the weather all week and missed two labs.
examples.zh: 她整整一周都「不大舒服」，缺了两次实验课。

words.enDefinition: whatever the weather is like

examples.en: The Saturday flea market runs every weekend, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 周六跳蚤市场每周都开，「风雨无阻」。

examples.en: I jog around the lake every morning, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 我每天早上绕湖跑步，「风雨无阻」。

words.enDefinition: politely postpone an invitation to a later time

examples.en: I have a lab report tonight, so can I take a rain check?
examples.zh: 今晚我要赶实验报告，能不能「改天再约」？

examples.en: She took a rain check on dinner but suggested Sunday instead.
examples.zh: 她把晚餐「改约到下次」，提议改到周日。

words.enDefinition: move something to a later time

examples.en: The professor postponed the quiz until after the reading week.
examples.zh: 教授把测验「推迟」到了阅读周之后。

examples.en: They postponed the career fair because of the storm warning.
examples.zh: 因为风暴预警，招聘会「延期」了。

words.enDefinition: arrange something for a different time

examples.en: Can we reschedule our study session to Thursday evening instead?
examples.zh: 我们的学习小组能「改到」周四晚上吗？

examples.en: I rescheduled my dentist appointment because it clashed with my seminar.
examples.zh: 我「重新约了」牙医的时间，因为和研讨课冲突了。

words.enDefinition: delay doing something, usually again and again

examples.en: I keep putting off my laundry until the basket overflows.
examples.zh: 我总「拖着」不洗衣服，直到篮子堆满。

examples.en: Don't put off booking your driving test; slots go fast.
examples.zh: 别「拖延」驾照考试的预约，名额很快就没了。

words.enDefinition: move a plan or meeting to a later time

examples.en: They pushed back the department party to avoid the storm.
examples.zh: 系里把聚会「往后推」，避开暴风雨。

examples.en: Can we push back our Thursday meeting by an hour?
examples.zh: 周四的会能「推后」一个小时吗？

words.enDefinition: move something to an earlier time

examples.en: The professor moved up the office hours to eleven a.m.
examples.zh: 教授把答疑时间「提前」到了上午十一点。

examples.en: Our flight moved up, so we must leave the dorm at five.
examples.zh: 航班「提前」了，我们得五点就出宿舍。

words.enDefinition: cancel a planned event or activity

examples.en: The coach called off practice because of the heat warning.
examples.zh: 因为高温预警，教练「取消」了训练。

examples.en: They called off the lakeside picnic when thunderclouds rolled in.
examples.zh: 雷雨云压过来时，他们「取消」了湖边野餐。

words.enDefinition: note something tentatively in a schedule, subject to change

examples.en: Let me pencil you in for Tuesday and confirm later.
examples.zh: 我先把你「暂定」在周二，之后再确认。

examples.en: Pencil in the review session; we might move it after the quiz.
examples.zh: 复习课先「暂定」下来，测验后也许还要调整。

words.enDefinition: manage to fit something into a busy schedule

examples.en: I squeezed in a gym session between my two lectures.
examples.zh: 我在两节课之间「挤出时间」去了趟健身房。

examples.en: Can you squeeze in a quick call with me before dinner?
examples.zh: 晚饭前你能「抽空」和我快速通个话吗？

words.enDefinition: make time available by rearranging plans

examples.en: I canceled my Friday club meeting to free up study time.
examples.zh: 我取消了周五的社团活动，好「腾出」学习时间。

examples.en: My new class schedule frees up my whole Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 新课表把我周五整个下午都「空出来」了。

words.enDefinition: last much longer than necessary or expected

examples.en: The orientation session dragged on for nearly three boring hours.
examples.zh: 迎新会「拖拖拉拉」开了将近三个小时。

examples.en: His story about the delayed flight dragged on and on.
examples.zh: 他讲航班延误的经历，「讲个没完」。

words.enDefinition: of time, pass very quickly

examples.en: Finals week flew by, and suddenly it was summer break.
examples.zh: 考试周「飞快过去」，转眼就放暑假了。

examples.en: Time flies by when you are having fun with friends.
examples.zh: 和朋友玩得开心时，时间总是「过得飞快」。

words.enDefinition: fill spare moments with something unimportant

examples.en: I kill time in the library between my morning classes.
examples.zh: 上午两节课之间，我在图书馆「消磨时间」。

examples.en: We killed time at a cafe while waiting for the rain to stop.
examples.zh: 等雨停的时候，我们在咖啡馆「打发时间」。

words.enDefinition: someone who misses an appointment without telling anyone

examples.en: The tutor charges for any no-show without prior cancellation of the lesson.
examples.zh: 家教对事先不取消就「爽约」的课要收费。

examples.en: My lab partner was a no-show again this morning, no text at all.
examples.zh: 我的实验搭档今天早上又「放了鸽子」，连消息都没发。

words.enDefinition: the times when a person or room is free

examples.en: Send me your availability for the group project this week.
examples.zh: 把你这周「有空的时间」发给我，安排小组项目。

examples.en: The advisor's booking page lists her availability for each day.
examples.zh: 导师的预约页面列出了她每天「可预约的时段」。

words.enDefinition: a fixed period assigned within a schedule

examples.en: My lab time slot moved to Tuesday afternoons this term.
examples.zh: 这学期我的实验「时间段」挪到了周二下午。

examples.en: Book a gym time slot through the app to avoid queues.
examples.zh: 用应用程序预约健身房「时段」，免得排队。

words.enDefinition: having no free appointments or times left

examples.en: The dentist is booked up until the end of the month.
examples.zh: 牙医的号「排满」到月底了。

examples.en: I am booked up all weekend with the hackathon and work shifts.
examples.zh: 这个周末我「排满了」黑客马拉松和打工的班。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of future weather conditions

examples.en: The forecast says sunshine all weekend, perfect for the picnic.
examples.zh: 「天气预报」说周末全程晴，野餐正合适。

examples.en: Check tomorrow's forecast before you bike to campus in the morning.
examples.zh: 明早骑车上学前，先看看「天气预报」。

words.enDefinition: light fine rain with small drops

examples.en: A thin drizzle fell during our entire two-hour campus tour.
examples.zh: 我们两个小时的校园参观一直伴着「毛毛雨」。

examples.en: The forecast mentions light drizzle in the morning, clearing by noon.
examples.zh: 天气预报提到早上有「毛毛雨」，中午转晴。

words.enDefinition: a sudden very heavy fall of rain

examples.en: We got caught in a downpour walking back from the station.
examples.zh: 从车站走回来时，我们遇上了「倾盆大雨」。

examples.en: That sudden downpour flooded the shortcut path near the gym.
examples.zh: 那场「瓢泼大雨」把健身房旁的近道都淹了。

words.enDefinition: the loud sound that follows a lightning flash

examples.en: The thunder woke everyone in the dorm around two a.m.
examples.zh: 凌晨两点左右的「雷声」把全宿舍都吵醒了。

examples.en: We saw the lightning flash first, then heard thunder seconds later.
examples.zh: 我们先看到闪电，几秒后才听到「雷声」。

words.enDefinition: a bright flash of electricity during a storm

examples.en: Lightning struck near the field, so the referee stopped the match.
examples.zh: 「闪电」击中球场附近，裁判中止了比赛。

examples.en: The sky lit up with lightning all through the night.
examples.zh: 整晚天空都被「闪电」照得发亮。

words.enDefinition: small balls of ice that fall like rain

examples.en: Hail battered the car windows during yesterday's brief afternoon storm.
examples.zh: 昨天下午那场短促的风暴里，「冰雹」砸在车窗上。

examples.en: The weather app warned of hail near the stadium tonight.
examples.zh: 天气应用提醒今晚体育场附近有「冰雹」。

words.enDefinition: a severe snowstorm with strong winds

examples.en: Yesterday's blizzard canceled every single shuttle bus to the airport.
examples.zh: 昨天的「暴风雪」让所有机场班车都停运了。

examples.en: Classes moved online after the blizzard dumped thirty centimeters of snow.
examples.zh: 「暴风雪」下了三十厘米厚的雪之后，课程改到了线上。

words.enDefinition: a thin white layer of ice on cold surfaces

examples.en: Frost covered the windshield, so I scraped it before class.
examples.zh: 挡风玻璃结满了「霜」，上课前我先把它刮掉。

examples.en: The first frost of the season killed the balcony basil.
examples.zh: 今季的第一场「霜冻」把我阳台的罗勒冻死了。

words.enDefinition: the amount of water vapor in the air

examples.en: The humidity makes my dorm room feel like a sauna.
examples.zh: 这「湿度」让我的宿舍感觉像蒸桑拿。

examples.en: The low winter humidity dries out my skin very badly.
examples.zh: 冬天空气「湿度」低，我的皮肤特别干。

words.enDefinition: how hot or cold the air is

examples.en: The temperature dropped ten degrees overnight, so please dress warmly.
examples.zh: 「气温」一夜降了十度，记得穿暖和些。

examples.en: Always check the outside temperature before dressing for morning classes.
examples.zh: 早课前先看看室外「气温」再决定穿什么。

words.enDefinition: a period of unusually hot weather

examples.en: The heat wave pushed the dorm cooling systems past their limits.
examples.zh: 「热浪」来袭，宿舍的制冷设备都快撑不住了。

examples.en: During the heat wave we studied in the air-conditioned library.
examples.zh: 「热浪」期间，我们都在有空调的图书馆学习。

words.enDefinition: a short period of sudden cold weather

examples.en: The sudden cold snap froze the campus fountain solid overnight.
examples.zh: 突如其来的「寒潮」一夜之间把校园喷泉冻住了。

examples.en: Dig out your winter coat; the cold snap starts tomorrow.
examples.zh: 把冬衣翻出来，「寒潮」明天就到。

words.enDefinition: a moving mass of cold air that changes the weather

examples.en: A cold front arrives Friday, bringing rain and gusty winds.
examples.zh: 周五有「冷锋」过境，带来降雨和大风。

examples.en: The weather app says a cold front will drop temperatures sharply.
examples.zh: 天气应用说「冷锋」会让气温骤降。

words.enDefinition: a violently rotating column of air from a storm

examples.en: The tornado warning sent the whole dorm to the basement stairwell.
examples.zh: 「龙卷风」警报一响，全楼的人都躲进了地下楼梯间。

examples.en: We practiced the campus tornado drill twice during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周我们练习了两次校园「龙卷风」演习。

words.enDefinition: a powerful tropical storm with very strong winds

examples.en: The hurricane forced the university to close campus for two days.
examples.zh: 「飓风」迫使大学停课两天。

examples.en: Before the hurricane, we taped the windows and stocked bottled water.
examples.zh: 「飓风」来临前，我们贴好窗户、备足了瓶装水。

words.enDefinition: the time of year with the most rain

examples.en: The rainy season here lasts from June to early August.
examples.zh: 这里的「雨季」从六月持续到八月初。

examples.en: Keep a folding umbrella in your backpack during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 「雨季」期间，记得在背包里放把折叠伞。

words.enDefinition: how clean or polluted the outdoor air is

examples.en: The air quality was so poor that outdoor practice got canceled.
examples.zh: 「空气质量」太差，室外训练被取消了。

examples.en: Wildfire smoke pushed the air quality index into the red zone.
examples.zh: 山火烟雾让「空气质量指数」进入了红色区间。

words.enDefinition: a small pool of water on the ground

examples.en: I stepped in a puddle on the way to my lecture.
examples.zh: 去上课的路上，我踩进了一个「水坑」。

examples.en: After the thunderstorm, puddles stretched across the whole parking lot.
examples.zh: 雷雨过后，停车场里到处都是「积水洼」。

words.enDefinition: unpleasantly warm and damp, hard to bear

examples.en: It gets muggy in the dorm at night without air conditioning.
examples.zh: 没有空调的时候，宿舍晚上「闷热」难耐。

examples.en: This muggy weather makes the pages of my textbooks feel damp.
examples.zh: 这种「闷热」天气让课本书页都发潮了。

words.enDefinition: unpleasantly cool, slightly too cold

examples.en: It gets chilly after sunset, so bring a hoodie to the game.
examples.zh: 日落后会「凉飕飕的」，看比赛记得带件连帽衫。

examples.en: The lecture hall is always chilly, so I keep a cardigan there.
examples.zh: 教室里总是「凉飕飕的」，我在那儿放了件开衫。

words.enDefinition: extremely cold, at or below the ice point

examples.en: The waiting room at the bus stop is absolutely freezing.
examples.zh: 公交站的候车室「冷得要命」。

examples.en: It is freezing in the library basement, so bring a thermos of tea.
examples.zh: 图书馆地下室「冷极了」，带壶热茶去吧。

words.enDefinition: burning hot, like the midday summer sun

examples.en: The scorching sidewalk made my walk to class truly miserable.
examples.zh: 「灼热」的人行道让我上学的路格外难受。

examples.en: We moved the picnic table into the shade during the scorching afternoon.
examples.zh: 「烈日炎炎」的下午，我们把野餐桌挪到了阴凉处。

words.enDefinition: pleasantly warm, not too hot or cold

examples.en: October here stays mild, perfect for reading outside on the lawn.
examples.zh: 这里的十月一直很「温和」，正适合在草坪上读书。

examples.en: The forecast promises a mild weekend with only light winds.
examples.zh: 天气预报说周末天气「温和」，只有微风。

words.enDefinition: with a light pleasant wind blowing

examples.en: It is breezy by the lake, ideal for flying kites.
examples.zh: 湖边「微风习习」，正适合放风筝。

examples.en: The breezy afternoon finally made the sticky humidity feel bearable.
examples.zh: 「有风」的下午，黏腻的湿气终于变得可以忍受。

words.enDefinition: bright with sunlight and few clouds

examples.en: It is sunny all week, so the quad will be packed.
examples.zh: 整周都是「晴天」，草坪上肯定全是人。

examples.en: The sunny weather finally lifted everyone's mood right before finals.
examples.zh: 期末前的「晴朗」天气让所有人的心情都好了起来。

words.enDefinition: covered with a lot of clouds

examples.en: It stays cloudy all week, so keep the rain jacket handy.
examples.zh: 整周都「多云」，雨衣要随手备着。

examples.en: The morning started cloudy but finally cleared up around noon.
examples.zh: 早晨「多云」，但中午前后终于放晴了。

words.enDefinition: covered with a full layer of gray clouds

examples.en: The sky stayed overcast, and our beach trip felt gloomy.
examples.zh: 天空一直是「阴沉沉的」，我们的海边之行都显得无精打采。

examples.en: Overcast mornings actually make the photo studio perfect for portraits.
examples.zh: 「阴天」的早晨其实最适合在摄影棚拍人像。

words.enDefinition: dark and depressing, with little light

examples.en: The gloomy rainy weather makes everyone drowsy during afternoon lectures.
examples.zh: 「阴沉」的雨天让下午课上人人昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: A week of gloomy skies calls for a cozy study party indoors.
examples.zh: 一整周「阴沉」的天空，正适合在室内办个温馨的学习派对。

words.enDefinition: of rain, falling very heavily

examples.en: It is pouring outside, so the intramural game is postponed.
examples.zh: 外面「雨下得很大」，校内联赛只能推迟。

examples.en: By the time we reached the dorm, it was pouring.
examples.zh: 我们走到宿舍时，雨已经「下成了瓢泼」。

words.enDefinition: full of fog, with poor visibility

examples.en: The entire campus looks mysterious and quiet on foggy November mornings.
examples.zh: 「有雾」的十一月清晨，整个校园神秘又安静。

examples.en: It was so foggy that the shuttle crawled along the road.
examples.zh: 那天「雾很大」，班车在路上慢得像爬。

words.enDefinition: covered with a thin, dangerous layer of ice

examples.en: The bridge stays icy all week, so walk around it.
examples.zh: 那座桥整周都「结着冰」，绕道走吧。

examples.en: Icy sidewalks in January forced everyone to walk like penguins.
examples.zh: 一月「结冰」的人行道让大家都走得像企鹅。

words.enDefinition: difficult to stand or walk on safely

examples.en: Wet leaves make the quad steps dangerously slippery every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，湿树叶都会把广场台阶弄得「很滑」。

examples.en: Be careful, the tile floor near the pool is slippery.
examples.zh: 小心，泳池边的瓷砖地面「很滑」。

words.enDefinition: fresh, dry, and pleasantly cool, like autumn air

examples.en: A crisp autumn morning is perfect for the walk to campus.
examples.zh: 「清爽」的秋日早晨最适合走路去学校。

examples.en: The air turned crisp overnight, signaling the start of fall.
examples.zh: 空气一夜之间变得「干爽」，秋天来了。

words.enDefinition: become warmer, said of the weather

examples.en: It is finally warming up, so the patio cafes are open again.
examples.zh: 天气终于「回暖」，露天咖啡馆又开门了。

examples.en: Afternoons warm up quickly in April, so dress in layers.
examples.zh: 四月午后「升温」很快，穿衣要有层次。

words.enDefinition: become cooler, said of the weather

examples.en: Evenings cool down fast here, so keep a jacket nearby.
examples.zh: 这里晚上「降温」很快，手边备件外套。

examples.en: The apartment finally cools down after ten o'clock at night.
examples.zh: 公寓要到晚上十点后才「凉快下来」。

words.enDefinition: become bright and free of clouds

examples.en: The rain cleared up just in time for the festival.
examples.zh: 雨正好在音乐节开始前「放晴」了。

examples.en: It looks cloudy now, but it should clear up by noon.
examples.zh: 现在天色阴沉，不过中午应该会「转晴」。

words.enDefinition: become less strong, said of rain or wind

examples.en: The rain finally let up, so we dashed to the dining hall.
examples.zh: 雨终于「小了」，我们冲向食堂。

examples.en: The wind let up around sunset, calming the lake surface.
examples.zh: 日落前后风终于「减弱」，湖面平静下来。

words.enDefinition: become stronger, said of wind or a storm

examples.en: The wind picked up during the concert, flipping our ponchos.
examples.zh: 演唱会上「风变大」，把我们的雨衣都掀翻了。

examples.en: The storm is expected to pick up again around midnight.
examples.zh: 预计风暴午夜前后再度「增强」。

words.enDefinition: pass and end without much damage, said of a storm

examples.en: The forecast says the storm will blow over by morning.
examples.zh: 天气预报说风暴到早上就会「平息」。

examples.en: We waited in the tunnel until the squall blew over.
examples.zh: 我们在通道里一直等到暴风雨「平息」。

words.enDefinition: force an event to be canceled because of rain

examples.en: The baseball final got rained out and moved to Sunday.
examples.zh: 棒球决赛「因雨取消」，改到周日举行。

examples.en: Our field trip was rained out, so we met in the lab instead.
examples.zh: 我们的实地考察「被雨搅了」，改在实验室碰头。

words.enDefinition: colder than the freezing point of water

examples.en: The wind pushed the temperature well below zero last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚大风把气温吹到了「零下」好几度。

examples.en: My water bottle froze because it stayed below zero all weekend.
examples.zh: 气温整个周末都在「零下」，我的水瓶都冻住了。

words.enDefinition: the temperature scale used in the United States

examples.en: My American roommates always quote temperatures in Fahrenheit, which confuses me.
examples.zh: 美国室友总用「华氏温度」报天气，让我很困惑。

examples.en: The app switches between Celsius and Fahrenheit in the settings.
examples.zh: 在设置里可以把应用切换成摄氏或「华氏」温度。

words.enDefinition: cream that protects skin from strong sun

examples.en: Remember to apply sunscreen before the noon beach volleyball practice.
examples.zh: 正午沙滩排球训练前，记得涂好「防晒霜」。

examples.en: The campus pharmacy sells sunscreen cheaper than the corner store.
examples.zh: 校内药店卖的「防晒霜」比街角商店便宜。
